queries_run: DDOG Datadog antitrust OR DOJ OR FTC OR EU competition investigation 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因子指出歐盟 AI Act（2024-08 生效）及美國各州隱私／AI 法規為一般性監管風險；未見針對 Datadog 的反壟斷調查或拆分事項。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: For example, the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act, which would apply beyond the European Union’s borders, came into effect in August 2024. It contains numerous requirements regarding the development and use of AI and imposes significant monetary fines.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋 DOJ/FTC/EU 對 Datadog 的調查 2026 無結果；僅一次搜尋，未涵蓋其他兩條 query。
